title: John Lear: the moon was built at Jupiter and towed to Earth

tellings.quote: they built the moon on Jupiter. And uh that's where they manufactured it and they towed it into Earth's orbit.

plain: The moon, so the story goes, was built at Jupiter, made there like a product, and then towed into orbit around Earth. Bob Lazar, a man who says he once worked on recovered alien craft for the US government, tells Michels this is what a veteran pilot named John Lear told him. If it were true, the moon would be a made object that someone placed next to Earth on purpose.
